```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(MASS)       # For ginv()
library(mvnpermute) # For mvnpermute()
library(matrixcalc) # For is.positive.semi.definite()
```
## Load data 
```{r}
fn_phenotypes <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/limma_gwas/gwas_set_all_plates_ds_controls/blups_gwas/log2_ddm_minus_col_average_per_replicate_union_set_filtered_te_gene_overlap_removed_outlier_replicates/1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected_acc.fam"  # Phenotype data (e.g., SNP or trait data)
fn_kinship <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/limma_gwas/gwas_set_all_plates_ds_controls/blups_gwas/log2_ddm_minus_col_average_per_replicate_union_set_filtered_te_gene_overlap_removed_outlier_replicates/1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected_acc.cXX.txt"    # Kinship matrix

# Load phenotype data
phenotypes <- read.csv(fn_phenotypes, sep = '\t', header = F)
n_acc <- nrow(phenotypes)

# Load kinship matrix
K <- as.matrix(read.csv(fn_kinship, sep = '\t', header = F))
```
## Check kinship matrix
```{r}
if (!is.positive.semi.definite(K)) {
  stop("Kinship matrix is not positive semi-definite.")
} else {
  print("Kinship matrix is valid (positive semi-definite).")
}
```

```{r}
# Use EMMA to calculate variance components
null <- emma.REMLE(phenotypes$V10, 
                    as.matrix(x = rep(1, n_acc), dim = c(n_acc, 1)), 
                    K)
herit <- null$vg / (null$vg + null$ve)

vg <- null$vg  # Genetic variance
ve <- null$ve  # Environmental variance

cat("Genetic Variance (vg):", vg, "\n")
cat("Environmental Variance (ve):", ve, "\n")
cat("Heritability (h²):", herit, "\n")
```
## Create a covariance matrix
```{r}
# Construct the covariance matrix
COV_MATRIX <- null$vg * K + null$ve * diag(dim(K)[1])
```

```{r}
n_permute <- 1000  # Adjust based on computational resources

# Permute the phenotypes
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
permute_phenotype <- mvnpermute(phenotypes$V10, 
                                rep(1, n_acc), 
                                COV_MATRIX, 
                                nr = n_permute)
n_permute <- ncol(permute_phenotype)
```
## Write output to the directory
```{r}
# Number of permutations
n_permute <- ncol(permute_phenotype)

# Set the parent directory
parent_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/limma_gwas/gwas_set_all_plates_ds_controls/blups_gwas/log2_ddm_minus_col_average_per_replicate_union_set_filtered_te_gene_overlap_removed_outlier_replicates_permutation"

# Create the parent directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(parent_dir)) {
  dir.create(parent_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Create directories for each permutation
for (i in 1:n_permute) {
  dir_name <- file.path(parent_dir, paste0("permutation_", i))
  if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) {
    dir.create(dir_name, showWarnings = FALSE)
  }
}

# Save each permuted phenotype into its respective directory
for (i in 1:n_permute) {
  dir_name <- file.path(parent_dir, paste0("permutation_", i))
  
  # Initialize the permuted data frame
  permuted_data <- data.frame(
    V1 = phenotypes$V1,
    V2 = phenotypes$V2,
    V3 = phenotypes$V3,
    V4 = phenotypes$V4,
    V5 = phenotypes$V5,
    V6 = permute_phenotype[, i]
  )
  
  # Construct the file path
  file_path <- file.path(dir_name, paste0("1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected_acc.fam"))
  
  # Save the data
  write.table(permuted_data, file_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = F, col.names = F, sep="\t")
  
  cat(paste0("Saved permutation ", i, " to ", file_path, "\n"))
}

cat("All permutations have been saved to their respective directories.\n")
```

### Extract test stat
```{r}
# Initialize an empty data frame to store test statistics
# Define the parent directory where permutation directories are stored
permuted_snps <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/gwas_set_all_plates_ds_controls/blups_gwas/log2_mean_centered_col0def_270acc_f1ddm1/permutations/output/top_snps_by_permutation.txt")
```



```{r}
### Calculate permuted thereshold 
alpha <- 0.05
threshold <- quantile(permuted_snps$p_wald, probs = alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
-log10(threshold)
```

```{r}
hist(min_p_per_perm, breaks = 50, 
     main = "Minimum P-value per Permutation",
     xlab = "p-value", col = "lightblue", xlim = c(0, max(min_p_per_perm)))
abline(v = threshold, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = paste("Threshold =", format(threshold, scientific = TRUE)), 
       col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```
```{r}
# Flatten all permuted p-values into a vector
all_perm_p <- as.vector(as.matrix(permuted_snps))
all_perm_p <- na.omit(all_perm_p)

# Compute λ
chi2 <- qchisq(all_perm_p, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
lambda <- median(chi2, na.rm = TRUE) / 0.454  # 0.454 = median of χ²(1) under null
cat("Genomic inflation factor (λ):", lambda)
```



```{r}
expected_p <- apply(permuted_snps, 1, function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
observed_p <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/limma_gwas/gwas_set_all_plates_ds_controls/blups_gwas/log2_ddm_minus_col_average_per_replicate_union_set_filtered_te_gene_overlap_removed_outlier_replicates/output/blups_union_effect_acc.assoc.txt", header = T)$p_wald
# QQ-plot
qqplot(-log10(expected_p), -log10(observed_p), main="QQ-Plot: Real vs Permuted P-values")
abline(0, 1, col="red")  # Add line of e
```
